description: Does the paralog ATOSB carry a HORMA module, and how conserved is the ATOSA module across vertebrates
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def frag(txt,a,b): return "\n".join(l for l in txt.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and a<=int(l[22:26])<=b)+"\nEND\n"
def foldseek(txt, db="afdb-swissprot", mode="tmalign"):
    tid=requests.post("https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket",files={"q":("q.pdb",txt)},
        data=[("mode",mode),("database[]",db)],timeout=300).json()["id"]
    for _ in range(120):
        s=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tid}",timeout=120).json()
        if s.get("status") in ("COMPLETE","ERROR"): break
        time.sleep(5)
    if s.get("status")!="COMPLETE": return []
    r=requests.get(f"https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tid}/0",timeout=300).json()
    al=r["results"][0]["alignments"]
    return al[0] if al and isinstance(al[0],list) else al

atosb=open("atosb_af_full.pdb").read()
print("ATOSB 340-538 mean pLDDT:",
      round(np.mean([float(l[60:66]) for l in atosb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA" and 340<=int(l[22:26])<=538]),1))
hb=foldseek(frag(atosb,340,538))
print("ATOSB 340-538 hits:", len(hb))
for h in hb[:10]: print(f'  TM={float(h["eval"]):.3f} {h["target"]} {h.get("taxName","")[:30]} seqId={h["seqId"]}')
hb2=foldseek(frag(atosb,1,230))
print("ATOSB 1-230 hits:", len(hb2))

# figure: ATOSA N-terminal module, TM to named SwissProt folds, plus cross-species conservation
df=pd.read_csv("foldseek_afdb_swissprot_atosa_atosb.csv")
a=df[df["query"].str.startswith("ATOSA")].copy()
a["short"]=a["target"].str.replace("AF-","",regex=False).str.split("-F1").str[0]
a["isatos"]=a["target"].str.contains("Atos homolog")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.4))
ax=axes[0]
hom=a[~a["isatos"]].head(10).iloc[::-1]
names={"P40958":"MAD2, S. cerevisiae","P0DTF6":"Cap7, P. aeruginosa","Q59VQ3":"MAD2, C. albicans",
       "Q556Y9":"MAD2A, D. discoideum","Q9Z1B5":"MAD2A, mouse","Q13257":"MAD2A, human",
       "Q94FL5":"REV7, A. thaliana","Q8N7B1":"HORMAD2, human","O13978":"ATG101, S. pombe"}
lab=[names.get(s,s) for s in hom["short"]]
ax.barh(range(len(hom)),hom["tm"],color="#c0392b")
ax.axvline(0.5,color="#2c3e50",ls="--",lw=1.2); ax.text(0.505,0.2,"same fold",fontsize=8,rotation=90,color="#2c3e50")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(hom))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("TM-score vs ATOSA 1-230"); ax.set_xlim(0,0.75)
ax.set_title("Non-Atos SwissProt folds matching ATOSA 1-230\nAll are HORMA proteins: MAD2, HORMAD2, REV7, ATG101",fontsize=10)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
ax2=axes[1]
sp=a[a["isatos"]].drop_duplicates("short")
sp2=sp[~sp["short"].str.startswith("Q32MH5")].iloc[::-1]
spn={"Q5FW46":"X. tropicalis","Q69ZK7":"mouse","Q69ZK7-2":"mouse iso2","Q5ZI58":"chicken","Q1LV22":"zebrafish","Q1LV22-2":"zebrafish iso2"}
ax2.barh(range(len(sp2)),sp2["seqId"],color="#2980b9")
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(sp2))); ax2.set_yticklabels([spn.get(s,s) for s in sp2["short"]],fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel("% sequence identity to human ATOSA over the 1-230 module")
ax2.set_xlim(0,100)
for i,v in enumerate(sp2["seqId"]): ax2.text(v+1.5,i,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_title("The module is conserved across vertebrate ATOSA orthologs\nwhile human ATOSB 1-230 is disordered (mean pLDDT 36.0) and returns no hits",fontsize=10)
ax2.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
